script_text: Stop, Leo — the cosmos just threw a mirror in your face and what you see tonight changes everything. As a fire sign ruled by the Sun, you're built to shine, but transiting Venus is revealing something hidden in your 1st House of Self. She's squaring fierce Mars in Aries, creating a blazing tension between your independence and your need for connection. If you're in a relationship, a conversation you've been dodging could finally surface — let sincerity win over pride. Meanwhile, the Sun and Mercury are both transiting your 2nd House of Finances, so a money matter will demand your attention — possibly a raise, a settlement, or an unexpected offer. Your fire element craves action, but beware: Mars square Venus is rushing your judgment and tempting you to sign something you shouldn't. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
